## Methods

### Raise

```csharp
void Raise(string eventName, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? data = null, PluginUser? user = null)
```

Raises an event. Automations whose trigger has this event name run.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `eventName` | The event, for example `acme.usb.connected`. It must start with the plugin id. |
| `data` | Values sent with the event, for example `drive = E:`. Trigger fields with the same name filter on them, and actions can use them as `{{ event.data.drive }}`. |
| `user` | The user the event is about, if any. User triggers (`user:`) filter on it. |
